latent_scale_escalation.avoid_under_scaling: increase relevant latent width, depth, slot count, or other capacity when a localized capacity bottleneck persists
latent_scale_escalation.avoid_over_scaling: stop capacity growth when additional capacity no longer improves the relevant fidelity frontier or creates unacceptable latency/resource cost
